A motion was made by Commissioner Rodriguez, seconded by Vice Chairmember Roman, to
approve recommendation and adopt Resolution No. 2022­010, as amended, to modify the table on page
10 of the Housing Element under the Program 27 to change R­1 Single Family Residential, to 7.2 units
per acre minimum and a 10 unit per acre maximum; R­2 Medium Density Residential ­ 17.4 units per
acre as a minimum and a 23 units per acre as maximum; R­3 Intermediate Residential ­ 18.9 units per
acre as a minimum and 25 units per acre as a maximum; R­4 High Density Residential ­ 23.5 units as
minimum and 30 units as maximum; in the C­2 zone, which is going to be a new downtown mixed use ­
no minimum residential density with a maximum of 25 units per acre; and the C­4 General Commercial
which will be the new commercial mixed use would have a 20 unit minimum density and a 30 unit per
acre maximum density.
